# AI Accounting

AI Accounting is a public marketing site for an AI-assisted personal finance and expense tracking app. It introduces mobile accounting, receipt analysis, budgeting, tags, statistics, and goal tracking.

## Public Pages
- English: https://free-accounting.vercel.app/en
- Chinese: https://free-accounting.vercel.app/zh
- Privacy: https://free-accounting.vercel.app/en/privacy
- Terms: https://free-accounting.vercel.app/en/terms

Search engines and AI crawlers may crawl the public marketing, privacy, and terms pages. Login, settings, record entry, and authenticated app pages are excluded from the sitemap.
